external.title: External agents (pilot)
external.pilot: Approved agents and synthetic inputs only. Do not enter customer data, real business data or secrets.
external.loadFailed: Unable to load. Refresh to retry.
external.pollFailed: Result connection interrupted. The task may still be running. Refresh to read server state.
external.unknown: Remote execution is unconfirmed. This session is locked. Ask an administrator to reconcile; do not repeat the operation.
external.empty: No approved external agents. Ask an administrator to configure the pilot.
external.invalidOutput: Unexpected output format. Showing the original text.
external.sendUnconfirmed: Server acceptance is unconfirmed. Retrying uses the same request key to avoid duplicate tasks.
external.lifecycle: Leaving this page does not stop the remote task. Cancellation, execution resume and Dify version pinning are unsupported. Returned actions remain text and are never executed locally.
external.published.title: Externally hosted
external.published.description: Published by your organization in Moss. Only agents authorized for your account appear here.
external.published.scope: Managed by your organization · Synthetic-data pilot
external.published.empty: No external agents are available. Ask an organization administrator to connect and publish one in Moss.
external.chat.unavailable: This agent is unavailable or no longer authorized. Existing history remains readable.
external.chat.inputHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
external.chat.capabilities: The model is configured by the agent publisher. Attachments, local tools and stopping remote execution are unavailable.
external.chat.historyReadOnly: External history supports opening and continuing conversations; batch deletion and export are unavailable.
external.chat.historyFailed: External history could not load. Click to retry.
external.chat.reconciled: An administrator recorded the review and closed this session. Start a new conversation; do not resubmit the original task.
external.sourceIdentityUnverified: The application source is declared by an administrator; its binding to the service credentials is unverified.
external.versions.noSelection: No accepted version selection is recorded.
external.registry.verified: Nexus registration signature checked by Moss
external.registry.boundary: The signature verifies registration metadata. Remote execution guarantees depend on the provider.
external.registry.unrecorded: No unified registration evidence was recorded for this task.
external.versions.snapshotOnly: This provider confirms a reviewed source snapshot, without an immutable execution guarantee.
external.versions.awaitingEvidence: No confirmed remote execution evidence has been received.
external.versions.sessionPinned: This conversation keeps its original version. Start a new conversation to switch versions.
external.versions.durableCapabilities: The version is selected when a conversation starts. View confirmed execution details in Version evidence. Text only; remote cancellation is unavailable.
external.usage.title: Capabilities and usage
external.taskCleanupPending: A response was received, but task access cleanup is not yet confirmed. Ask an administrator to check; do not submit again.
external.credentialDisclosure: The service echoed a task credential. The response was blocked and access is being revoked.
external.usage.scope: The chat accepts synthetic test text only, without attachments, resource references or user-selected tools. Agent tool permissions are reviewed separately.
external.usage.classification: The caller declares the data category; content detection is not performed. Do not submit real business or sensitive data.
external.usage.basis: Capabilities describe the current adapter contract, not live connectivity or evidence of a particular run. Admission is checked again when submitting a task.
external.usage.evidence: Source identity is unverified; the source digest proves only the reviewed snapshot. Recovery queries the same remote run and never automatically re-executes an unknown task.
external.usage.unavailable: Usage information was not provided by the service. Refresh or contact your administrator.
external.modelRejection.MODEL_CONTENT_DE: The execution service reports that content policy blocked this request before sending it to the model. Revise the content before submitting again; no automatic retry will occur.
external.modelRejection.MODEL_CLASSIFIER: The execution service reports that content screening is unavailable and stopped this model request before sending. Contact your administrator; no automatic retry will occur.
external.modelRejection.MODEL_REDACTION_: The execution service reports that safe redaction failed and stopped this model request before sending. Revise the content or contact your administrator; no automatic retry will occur.
external.protocol.singleTurn: Each message runs independently. Previous conversation history is not sent to this Agent.
external.protocol.noRun: This protocol did not return a remote task ID.
external.protocol.usage: Provider-reported tokens: input {{input}}, output {{output}}. This is not verified billing.

hosted.description: Hosted agents published and authorized by your organization.
hosted.unavailable: Hosted tasks are unavailable or your access has changed. Refresh to try again.
hosted.synthetic: Synthetic test text only. Each turn runs independently without chat history. Do not enter real business data.
hosted.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested; verifying execution and credential cleanup
hosted.actionFailed: Operation unconfirmed. Refresh the task before retrying. Tasks are never resubmitted automatically.
hosted.unknown: Outcome unknown. Reconciliation only cleans up execution and credentials; it never resubmits the task or declares success.
hosted.closeNote: Record the reconciliation conclusion (does not change the outcome)
